name: claude-code-auth-flow
title: Claude Code authentication
description: Authenticate Claude Code CLI via OAuth with Google sign-in
preconditions: Verify comet-cdp is up (port 9222) — run: comet-cdp status
Verify the CLI tool is installed and available in PATH
Run: <cli> auth login — it prints an OAuth URL

vars.name: auth_url
vars.description: The OAuth URL printed by the CLI

vars.name: google_account
vars.description: Google account to select. Pass full email.

steps.rationale: Open the OAuth authorization URL from the CLI
steps.on_failure: If redirected to /login, the session has expired — sign in manually first, then retry

steps.rationale: Check if already authenticated (redirects to consent) or shows login page
Session is logged out — need to sign in via Google
steps.condition: URL contains '/login' or page shows 'Log in' heading

then.rationale: Find the 'Continue with Google' button
Initiate Google OAuth — opens a new tab for the Google account picker
Switch to the Google account picker tab
See the list of Google accounts
Account is in the picker — click it directly
then.condition: the desired account {{google_account}} is visible in the list

then.rationale: Select the correct Google account
Check for Google consent screen
Google asks for consent to share account info
then.condition: page shows 'Continue' button or 'signing back in' text

then.rationale: Approve Google consent — the Google tab closes and redirects back
Switch back to the app tab — Google auth completed
Check if captcha or consent screen appeared
hCaptcha blocks automated flows — reload to clear it
Reload the page to clear the captcha
Wait for page to reload
Re-check after reload — captcha should be gone

steps.rationale: Check for the OAuth consent/authorize screen
OAuth may show a consent screen granting the CLI tool access
steps.condition: page shows 'Authorize' or 'Allow' or 'Continue' button for CLI access

then.rationale: Scroll down to enable the Authorize button (disabled until scrolled into view)
Brief wait for button state to update
Re-snapshot after scroll — button should be enabled
Approve the OAuth request for the CLI
then.on_failure: If click doesn't navigate, reload the page and retry — captcha may have blocked the click

steps.rationale: Verify the callback — URL should contain the auth code parameter
The callback has the auth code — the CLI should pick it up

then.rationale: Wait for the CLI to exchange the code and confirm authentication

success_signal: CLI prints 'Successfully authenticated' or callback URL contains code parameter
